case.summary: The evidence supports fraud on this customer report alert for card C07297-K1, at a fraud probability of 0.90 resting on 3 independent signal(s): $482.12 is the largest or near-largest amount this card has ever authorised - 97% of its 101 prior transactions were smaller; the cardholder does not recognise the transaction (arrived as the trigger); 3 prior authorisations on this card in the preceding hour. The activity fits account takeover: the transaction runs on a device new to the account together with a burst of authorisations around it, which points at control of the account rather than use of the card alone. The closest alternative was card_not_present_new_device (0.65 against 0.85): a card-not-present transaction on a device new to the account. Recommended actions: BLOCK_CARD, CREATE_CASE, with exposure of $482.12.
